payload.claim: "`ready_task` also rebuilds an `ORPHANED` cell that reviewed clean" attributes the state ORPHANED to the cell, but ORPHANED is a task state (`saffron/ledger.py`'s TaskState list, set via `ledger.set_task_state(task_id, "ORPHANED")` in `saffron/cell/session.py` and `saffron/reconcile.py`). The code's own docstrings get this right, e.g. `ReadyTask`'s dataclass docstring says "an `ORPHANED` task whose cell went green," correctly separating the two nouns. This line, in the repo's own standing-instructions file, blurs the cell/task distinction the vocabulary is built on.
